interpretation: Original normal Amiga and alternate startup each set D0=32597635, D1=(encoded byte span lowWORD>>2)-1, A1=encoded byte span and A2=novella encoded payload address, LEA app+AC intoA3, then MOVEM.L D0-D1/A1-A2,-(A3). Shared decoded footprint is four LONGs/16bytes, so stored frame occupies app9C..AC, with register order D0,D1,A1,A2 in ascending memory. Original readers LEA app9C,A3 then MOVEM.L (A3)+,D0-D1/A1-A2 in protection phases and load-menu path. Define one16-byte inline canonical saved-state owner and four register-storage fields, not unrelated app9C/A0/A4/A8 guesses. D1 is a32-bit saved register but DBF uses its lowWORD. A1 is the full end-minus-start span, including the original two-byte tail not processed by871 LONG operations; it is not the processed LONG-byte count. Payload pointer is original runtime/mapped-source address, not decoded-view coordinates. Preserve original redundant phase1 reload/recomputation, key arithmetic, gate state and encoded bytes; no protection bypass, guest injection or new runtime capture. AppAC is a one-past address, not evidence of a four-byte memory access there. Native qualified endpoint binding renders canonical owner+16 where original app-base state permits; weak/foreign contexts retain their evidence limits. Native predecrement uses full decoded scalar/MOVEM span and retains known resulting app cursor; no loop-trip proof, stored-register value cache or unconditional typed-record MOVEM extension. Require declared full owner for access projection and keep hardware/base ambiguity, unowned spans, clobbers, shared updates and EA-register-in-list refusal. Existing raw generic aliases may remain in analysis/header even when actual source expressions are already meaningful; do not claim each is an unresolved semantic field.

cause.framework: Known app-cursor projection explicitly refused predecrement and retained only postincrement updates. A declared16-byte synthetic frame lost both the predecrement MOVEM store and following read; direct forward read already worked.
cause.target: Original saved frame had no canonical9C..AC owner. Only the one-past AC address was named as a nominal app_00AC field. Native spans need a declared full owner; appearance of a four-byte LEA displacement is not a four-byte memory access.
cause.renderer: The existing qualified RSSET use-site index handled physical spans only. It now accepts zero-width address formation at an unambiguous canonical owner start/end, retaining native known-base qualification and memory/alias guards.

fix.app_cursor: Reuse the shared generated element-width/register-count footprint. Subtract the whole span before predecrement access; retain the resulting cursor, including postincrement one-past values. No per-node arrays, target addresses, independent transfer engine or cap increase.
fix.address_projection: Extend existing native use-site facts and frozen rendering. Interior members retain their normal resolver; different adjacent/alias owner names remain ambiguous. Actual memory accesses still need full containment.
preserved_refusals: Unknown/clobbered or hardware/foreign bases, A7, striped/indexed access, unsupported shared updates.
MOVEM EA register in its list; no claimed stored-value semantics for that form.
Uncovered spans and unknown A6 at hardware-offset endpoint coincidence.

fields.name: loop_counter_register
fields.limit: Stored32 bits; DBF consumes low WORD.

fields.name: encoded_payload_span_bytes
fields.limit: Full computed byte span, including original two-byte tail.

frame.runtime: No new gameplay run or guest-state injection. These are original static producer/consumer coordinates and a separate synthetic CPU oracle.
frame.source_endpoint: Both original startup LEAs render owner+16. Actual MOVEM operand syntax is unchanged.

projection.reader_provenance: Three declared_layout_a6_fallback reads: declared owner disambiguates the numeric hardware-offset collision, without proving arbitrary A6 values.
projection.typed_fields: No fabricated per-register or per-field memory reads. The one bulk operand spans16 bytes; field descriptions record register storage roles, not sixteen-byte access to one four-byte field.

validation.cpu_oracle: Synthetic Musashi68000 store/restore: four distinct register values appear as D0,D1,A1,A2 at ascending LONG slots, A3 subtracts/adds16. Not a normal-input original game trace.
validation.new_test_cases: 24 app-predecrement cases including CPU oracle;8 endpoint cases;1 added existing-span positive. Unknown/cross-boundary/foreign/hardware/clobber/list conflict negatives retained.
validation.stale_fixture: One pre-existing C test still called lookup_proven_app_base_access, renamed in c8948067 to recorded+out_proven. Adapted its call while preserving every original proof assertion and additionally checking fallback recorded-but-not-proven and unspecified refusal.

performance.recovery: First native artifact was lost when non-TTY stdin reached EOF after successful baseline. Files were preserved. One persistent-terminal replacement matched baseline metadata and rendered source exactly before normal guarded command adoption; no bypass of current-row validation.
performance.scope: Measured required runs, not a causal speedup or whole-process memory claim. Scalar local cursor bookkeeping and existing use-site index; no new persistent analysis cache.

limits: Original binaries/code/data and unrelated paused work unchanged; byte equality is not all-path semantics.
Three reader base attributions remain explicitly conditional fallback, not register-state proof.
No loop-trip bounds, valid-lifetime or stored-register value cache inferred. Typed-record MOVEM propagation remains separate.
Raw generic address-marker/alias declarations can remain in the header even when actual source expressions are resolved. app_00AC is now header-only; it is not a demonstrated four-byte access.
The two PRNG byte aliases already render as shared_random_state_a+2/shared_random_state_b+3; their generic native alias names are not missing semantics.
No new gameplay or all-platform protected-path qualification; existing normal-input evidence remains separately scoped.

next.group: Remaining generic app signals and actual unresolved consumers
next.experiment: Separate unused inferred address/alias declarations from missing meanings using the frozen plan; inspect original alternate random-state initialization and unclaimed consumer inbound paths before any code promotion. Avoid naming-only reductions or assuming no reader means dead.
